$comment: Scope source of truth. Only checker promotes done; evidence and review state are preserved.

features.name: Java 21 Maven baseline
features.behavior: The repository has a Java 21 Maven build whose standard harness startup executes a real green-or-red test suite from a clean checkout
features.falsifier: The baseline exits green with no manifest or tests, uses a JDK other than 21, or swallows a failing Maven test [X-004]

context.note: Use Java 21 and Maven; init.mjs detects pom.xml and prefers ./mvnw.

features.name: Sanitized normalized ingestion
features.behavior: IngestService.ingest(String) parses one serialized v1 JSON object, returns the stable accepted or rejection result, and invokes IndexPort exactly once only with a sanitized normalized document for an eligible valid record
features.falsifier: The service bypasses the serialized ingress seam, accepts an out-of-scope, incomplete, or unsupported-major record, invokes IndexPort for a rejection or other than exactly once for an acceptance, or exposes a configured secret or additive-field overwrite in the indexed document [INV-SCOPE-1] [INV-REDACT-1] [INV-META-1] [INV-SCHEMA-1]

context.note: Implement the approved ingest(String) -> IngestResult seam over a supplied IndexPort: validate scope and required wire fields, normalize, redact, then make the single index call; use the five stable rejection codes and the context packet rather than exposing parser helpers.

features.name: Ingest schema and safety contract
features.behavior: A black-box ingest contract proves additive schemaVersion 1 compatibility and rejects unsafe scope, metadata, redaction, and major-version cases before indexing
features.falsifier: Happy-path JSON passes while an additive schemaVersion 1 field is rejected, or a missing identity field, configured secret, or schemaVersion 2 record is indexed [INV-SCOPE-1] [INV-REDACT-1] [INV-META-1] [INV-SCHEMA-1]

context.note: Drive IngestService.ingest(String) with the exact v1 JSON wire shape and capture IndexPort; assert Accepted or the stable rejection code plus call count, and never call parser or normalization helpers.

evidence.result: Tests run: 5, failures: 5, errors: 0. Every condition fails with a JUnit assertion that the required public serialized-ingest contract io.harness.logcontext.ingest.IngestService is absent; the test compiles, the v1 fixture loads, and no failure is a compile error or missing fixture. This is the expected pre-implementation red for TCON-INGEST-0001 through TCON-INGEST-0005.

features.name: OpenSearch log index adapter
features.behavior: The OpenSearch adapter installs a seven-day schemaVersion 1 mapping and supports constrained time, Kubernetes identity, message, and test.run_id searches over sanitized documents
features.falsifier: The adapter uses incompatible field types, omits seven-day retention, or returns records outside requested time and identity filters [INV-META-1] [INV-CORR-1] [X-002] [X-003]

context.note: Map observedAt as date, identity/correlation as exact fields, and message for full-text search behind the index port.

features.name: OpenSearch storage contract
features.behavior: A real OpenSearch integration proof indexes sanitized records and retrieves only exact run-id or namespace/workload/half-open-window matches through the typed index port
features.falsifier: A fake or raw OpenSearch client passes while the public OpenSearchLogIndex/IndexPort round trip loses a named field, RunIdLogQuery broadens beyond its exact run id, or WorkloadWindowLogQuery drops namespace, workload, or either half-open time bound [INV-META-1] [INV-CORR-1] [X-002]

context.note: Construct OpenSearchLogIndex(OpenSearchClient, indexName) against an authorized ephemeral real store; index via IndexPort.index, search only via RunIdLogQuery or WorkloadWindowLogQuery, and assert returned NormalizedLogRecord values plus exact filtering without calling the client directly. An unavailable Docker/OPENSEARCH runtime is an environment checkpoint, not behavioral red or green.

evidence.result: Environment unavailable: Docker cannot connect to /Users/loren/.colima/default/docker.sock and no OPENSEARCH environment is configured. No real OpenSearch instance was available, so this is not recorded as red behavioral evidence. Separately, the approved contract defines IndexPort.index(NormalizedLogRecord) but no query method or OpenSearchLogIndex construction seam, so TCON-INDEX-0001 through TCON-INDEX-0003 cannot be implemented through the index port without inventing an API.

features.checkerNotes: RESOLVED DESIGN: approved digest 64a7b9ee26db6b10 defines OpenSearchLogIndex(OpenSearchClient, String), IndexPort.search(LogQuery), exact RunIdLogQuery, conjunctive WorkloadWindowLogQuery, half-open TimeWindow, and bounded LogQueryResult. The real OpenSearch environment remains a test-implementation checkpoint, not a design gap; see DECISIONS.md and loop/context-packets/feat-005.json.

features.name: Bounded read-only MCP service
features.behavior: The authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP service exposes only search_logs and get_failure_context and enforces correlation, 15-minute, 200-record, 256-KiB, five-second, and no-pagination limits
features.falsifier: A tool falls back from a supplied run id, accepts an unbounded request, exceeds a budget, writes the index, or invokes Kubernetes [INV-CORR-1] [INV-BOUND-1] [INV-READ-1] [X-006] [X-007]

context.note: Use supplied test.run_id exclusively; otherwise require namespace, workload, and interval, then cap before reading.

features.name: MCP wire and authorization contract
features.behavior: A Streamable HTTP contract proves ServiceAccount JWT authorization, the exact two-tool surface, bounded truncation metadata, validation errors, and absence of write or Kubernetes capabilities
features.falsifier: Direct tests pass while a missing or invalid JWT reaches tool dispatch or index query, a valid JWT is denied before normal validation, initialization exposes non-tool capabilities, the tool list contains anything beyond search_logs and get_failure_context, an unknown tool reaches the index, or a pagination, response-size, or deadline bound is violated [INV-AUTH-1] [INV-TOOLS-1] [INV-BOUND-1] [INV-READ-1]

context.note: Start the real loopback HTTP boundary only through McpServiceBootstrap.start(McpHttpServerConfig(port 0), capturing IndexPort, deterministic ServiceAccountJwtValidator), drive endpoint() as an MCP client, and always close RunningMcpServer; observe authorization, closed tool surface, budgets, and side effects only through wire responses and captured dependencies.

evidence.result: 10 assertion failures: Required public MCP contract is absent: io.harness.logcontext.mcp.McpServiceBootstrap; compilation and the default baseline remain green

features.checkerNotes: RESOLVED DESIGN: owner-approved digest 4ff1c56ce4b88469 defines McpServiceBootstrap.start(McpHttpServerConfig, IndexPort, ServiceAccountJwtValidator), loopback port 0, RunningMcpServer.endpoint(), and close() for a deterministic real-HTTP oracle. The 11-feature DAG and feat-007 wire/auth scope remain unchanged; see DECISIONS.md and loop/context-packets/feat-007.json.

features.name: Collector preflight and opt-in deployment
features.behavior: The Helm deployment installs a scoped OpenTelemetry Collector DaemonSet that preflights node-log access, collects only opted-in test workloads, enriches identity and test.run_id, and sends schemaVersion 1 JSON records to ingest
features.falsifier: The chart omits preflight, reads non-opted-in workloads, drops metadata, or permits traffic outside ingest [INV-SCOPE-1] [INV-META-1] [A-006] [X-001] [X-003] [X-008]

context.note: Fail preflight loudly and retain sidecar as the explicit fallback; implement the owner-approved Docker/OCI launcher with the immutable lock, read-only fixtures, health readiness and bounded forced cleanup; do not silently broaden host access or substitute a fake collector.

features.name: Collector-to-ingest contract
features.behavior: A collector pipeline contract sends each representative opted-in container log as one compatible enriched schemaVersion 1 UTF-8 JSON object per ingress request and excludes non-opted-in records
features.falsifier: Static YAML passes while the Collector wraps records in an incompatible batch envelope, emits a wrong-typed or incomplete v1 object, loses Kubernetes or test metadata, or forwards an excluded pod [INV-SCOPE-1] [INV-META-1] [INV-SCHEMA-1]

context.note: Execute the real collector config against a capture ingress endpoint; assert one UTF-8 JSON object per request matches the approved v1 types and can be submitted through IngestService.ingest(String).

evidence.result: Tests run: 4, failures: 4, errors: 0. All four validated conditions compile and load their fixtures, then fail because the required public collector contract io.harness.logcontext.collector.CollectorContractConfig is absent. This is the expected pre-implementation red, not a compile or fixture failure.

features.name: Cluster access policy
features.behavior: The chart gives the collector only scoped log-read and ingest egress while MCP accepts cluster-internal authenticated traffic and reaches OpenSearch without exposing either backend to callers
features.falsifier: Rendered policy grants broad Kubernetes access, exposes OpenSearch, allows unauthenticated MCP, or blocks the intended path [INV-READ-1] [X-007]

context.note: Keep Kubernetes and OpenSearch credentials server-side; encode the one-way edges in NetworkPolicy.

features.name: Kubernetes diagnostic-context journey
features.behavior: A namespace-isolated Kubernetes journey emits a unique correlated log from an opted-in workload and retrieves its redacted Kubernetes and test context only through authenticated MCP before bounded cleanup
features.falsifier: Components pass alone but the full flow loses context, leaks a secret, crosses correlation, bypasses MCP, hangs, or leaves resources [INV-JOURNEY-1] [INV-REDACT-1] [INV-CORR-1] [INV-BOUND-1] [INV-READ-1]

context.note: Use unique namespace/marker, explicit deadlines, MCP-only assertions, and trapped cleanup; report A-006 preflight distinctly.
